name: Supabase
description: Postgres development platform providing backend features including database, auth, storage, realtime, and edge functions.

evidence.claim: Supabase is the Postgres development platform providing backend features like database, auth, storage, and edge functions.
Every request to Supabase carries an API key (publishable or secret key).
Official Supabase MCP repository exists to connect Supabase projects to AI assistants.

notes: Supabase provides extensive developer tooling, client libraries, REST/Realtime endpoints via PostgREST, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
